children: The latest GDP numbers from the U.K. may interest economists tracking AI's economic impact. Growth unexpectedly rose in July, with computer programming making the biggest contribution.

Within that sector, many of the businesses reporting the largest revenue growth were "involved in activities related to artificial intelligence and cloud computing," the U.K.'s Office for National Statistics said.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
